tagline.en: A 14B Apache-2.0 video editing model — reference- and mask-guided editing of existing footage.
tagline.zh: 14B、Apache-2.0 的视频编辑模型——基于参考图与掩码引导编辑已有素材。

en: SAMA 14B is a 14B-scale video model focused on editing rather than generating from scratch. It reworks existing footage under guidance, so you steer the result instead of relying on a prompt alone.

It supports reference-guided video, where a reference image conditions the look of the edit, and mask-conditioned video, where a mask marks which region to change. The weights are released under Apache-2.0.
In WorldFoundry, SAMA 14B runs through the shared pipeline — provide your source video along with a reference and/or mask, and it writes out the edited result.
zh: SAMA 14B 是一个 14B 规模的视频模型,专注于编辑而非从零生成。它在引导下对已有素材进行改写,让你掌控结果,而不仅依赖提示词。
它支持参考图引导视频(以一张参考图约束编辑的外观)与掩码条件视频(用掩码标出要修改的区域)。权重以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,SAMA 14B 通过统一 pipeline 运行——提供源视频以及参考图和/或掩码,它就输出编辑后的结果。

whenToUse.en: Use SAMA 14B when you need to edit existing video with reference-image or mask guidance rather than generate a clip from a text prompt alone.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要在参考图或掩码引导下编辑已有视频,而非仅凭文本提示词生成片段时,可以使用 SAMA 14B。

notFor.en: It's an editing model, so it expects source video plus guidance — it isn't a pure text-to-video generator. At 14B, plan for adequate GPU memory.
notFor.zh: 它是编辑模型,需要源视频加引导——不是纯粹的文生视频生成器。14B 规模请预留充足的显存。
